Spaced practice schedules review across multiple sessions instead of one long cramming session.
Retrieval practice strengthens long-term retention by asking learners to recall information without looking at their notes.
Combining spaced practice with retrieval practice improves durable learning and makes future recall easier.
Working memory is limited, so short focused study sessions reduce cognitive overload.
The main concepts in this summary are spacing, active recall, durable retention, and manageable study sessions.
